title: QKVShare: Quantized KV-Cache Handoff for Multi-Agent On-Device LLMs
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache compression, Quantization

problem_statement.en: Multi-agent LLM systems on edge devices must hand off latent context between agents, but the practical options today are expensive full re-prefill or memory-heavy full-precision (FP16) KV cache transfer; KV caches grow linearly with context length and quickly dominate the limited memory of small edge GPUs.
problem_statement.zh: 邊緣裝置上的多 agent LLM 系統需要在 agent 之間傳遞潛在 context，然而現行可行做法僅有昂貴的完整 re-prefill，或佔用大量記憶體的全精度（FP16）KV cache 傳輸；KV cache 隨 context 長度線性成長，會快速耗盡小型邊緣 GPU 的有限記憶體。

key_innovation.en: Quantized CacheCard handoff between agents: a topology-aware controller extends the "Don't Waste Bits" per-token features with downstream-demand and segment signals to assign mixed-precision bit-widths ({2,4,8,16}), packages quantized KV groups plus bit-width metadata into a self-contained CacheCard, and injects it at the receiver via a HuggingFace-compatible dequantize-then-inject path.
key_innovation.zh: 以量化 CacheCard 在 agent 間傳遞 KV 狀態：topology-aware controller 在「Don't Waste Bits」的 per-token 特徵上加入 downstream-demand 與 segment 訊號，配置 {2,4,8,16} 混合精度 bit-width；將量化 KV groups 與 bit-width metadata 打包為自足的 CacheCard，並經由與 HuggingFace 相容的 dequantize-then-inject 路徑注入接收端。

baselines_compared: FP16 re-prefill, FP16 cache copy (llama.cpp), Uniform Q4/Q8 sharing, Local-only adaptive quantization

key_improvements.en: Handoff reduces TTFT versus full re-prefill at every tested context (130.7 ms vs 150.2 ms at 1K; 397.1 ms vs 1029.7 ms at 8K); adaptive topology-aware Q8 reaches 82.67% GSM8K accuracy at 5 hops vs 71.33% for uniform Q8; uniform Q4 fits 2.8x more concurrent 8K contexts than FP16 (64 vs 23 agents).
key_improvements.zh: 在所有測試 context 長度下，handoff 皆較完整 re-prefill 降低 TTFT（1K 時 130.7 ms vs 150.2 ms；8K 時 397.1 ms vs 1029.7 ms）；topology-aware 自適應 Q8 在 5 hops 下達到 82.67% GSM8K 精度（uniform Q8 為 71.33%）；uniform Q4 可容納的並行 8K context 數為 FP16 的 2.8x（64 vs 23 agents）。

ai_task: Multi-agent Systems, AI Inference KV Cache transfer, KV Cache Compression
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU (12 GB)
